First, note there are only two positions (1 and 2).  
From the second clue, the videographer must be to the left of the person who watches animation. With only two positions, this forces the videographer to be in position 1 and the animation watcher to be in position 2.  

The first clue says the pakistani person is adjacent to the videographer. Since the videographer is in position 1, the pakistani person must be in position 2 (the only adjacent spot).  

Because each attribute value is unique across the two people, the pakistani person cannot also be the videographer. Therefore:
